turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We need a new couch and I can't decide between the ones we saw this weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a big sectional in grey, really comfy, but it might not fit through our door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a leather sofa, easy to clean, but it gets cold in winter and sticky in summer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a smaller blue velvet couch that looks gorgeous but only seats three.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The sectional sounds the comfiest, but definitely measure the doorway before buying it. Leather is great with kids or pets since it wipes clean. The velvet couch is beautiful, but seating three could be tight if you have guests over often.
